title: Pals Rewards Points on Tailwise Training Enrollments
content:
Paid Tailwise Training enrollments earn Pals Rewards points on the price paid, at the Pals Rewards base earn rate multiplied by the course's points multiplier. Guarantee repeats earn nothing. Points are earned on the enrollment, with the enrollment date as the date of earning.

| Course or pack | Points multiplier on the Pals Rewards base earn rate |
|---|---|
| Puppy Training 6-Week Group | 2 |
| Adult Basic Training 6-Week Group | 2 |
| Intermediate Training 6-Week Group | 2 |
| Advanced Training & CGC Prep 6-Week Group | 2 |
| Private Training 4-Session Pack | 1 |
| Private Training 8-Session Pack | 1 |

**In short.** Each of the four 6-Week Group courses earns at twice the Pals Rewards base earn rate; each Private Training pack earns at the base earn rate itself (a multiplier of 1).

**Which enrollments earn.**

| Kind of enrollment | Points earned |
|---|---|
| Paid enrollment | On the price paid, at the base earn rate multiplied by the course's multiplier |
| Guarantee repeat | None |

**Illustration (hypothetical base earn rate and price).** Taking a hypothetical base earn rate of 1 point per dollar and a price paid of 100.00: a group course with a multiplier of 2 earns 200 points; a private pack with a multiplier of 1 earns 100 points; a guarantee repeat earns 0 points.

The base earn rate itself belongs to the customer's Pals Rewards membership, and the points earned are booked to the customer's Pals Rewards points ledger.
